tokens_version_restamp: 2.1.0 -> 2.3.0 on 2026-08-04 by /idea-render-mockup. NOT a re-render. Verified: every colour var this render injects matches design-tokens.yaml 2.3.0 in BOTH the light :root block and the prefers-color-scheme:dark block (3400 vars across the 23 re-stamped screens, 0 mismatches). Tokens 2.2.0 and 2.3.0 are additive on the colour and type surfaces a preview consumes. states[].hash was NOT recomputed and is unchanged — this stamp asserts palette currency only, not full input-SHA currency.
two_schemes_note: BEN-005 renders the IBAN scheme label and DE89370400440532013000 alongside four SortCodeAccountNumber rows. Five payees are fixtured precisely so the list must render two identification schemes side by side without one formatting the other (TC-BEN-001).
avatar_note: Initials come from the PERSON, not the servicing institution — BEN-005 shows PR (Priya Rajan) while its displayed creditor reads N26 GmbH. Avatars are aria-hidden: a screen reader announcing 'P R' before the name it abbreviates is noise (TC-BEN-009).
empty_hides_search: empty omits the search bar entirely. A search field over an empty set invites the conclusion that search is broken (TC-BEN-003).
error_variant: Renders the 401 UK.OBIE.Header.Invalid variant: Retry shown, View Consents ABSENT. The 403 ConsentMismatch variant inverts both (TC-BEN-004 / TC-BEN-008).
